desc: Scroll start: PitchBook-style page begins moving up; banner and headline shift upward and the page scales slightly across the three tiles.
Scroll continues: banner headline now near the top edge and body paragraphs rise toward the middle of the frame.
Banner headline and subhead exit through the top of the frame while the first body paragraph moves up; zoom grows slightly.
Only the lower banner subhead and byline remain visible; body paragraphs keep rising and the page keeps enlarging.
Banner reduced to a thin strip at top; two body paragraphs sit mid-frame, still scrolling up with slight scale change.
Scroll decelerating: banner strip shrinking at the top, body paragraphs enlarged and nearly at their final position.
Banner mostly gone; paragraphs continue to move up and enlarge, empty white space growing below.
Body paragraphs near final scroll position with only a narrow banner remnant at top; motion slowing.
Late scroll frames: paragraphs drift a few pixels up, banner strip nearly out of view.
Final small settling movement of the scrolled page; banner remnant thinner, paragraph block slightly higher.
Page almost at rest; tiny upward shift visible in the paragraph block and banner edge.
Residual ease-out of the scroll: paragraphs creep upward by a few pixels; cursor mark appears near the first paragraph.
Scroll practically settled; last pixel-level movement of the text and a small I-beam cursor mark in the first paragraph.
Second scroll run: article text moves upward revealing a new 'Proceeds are expected...' paragraph; blue selection moves with the page.
Scroll settling; by the post tile a smiling presenter with pointer stick has popped in at lower right overlapping the new paragraph.
Presenter fully visible at lower right; a tiny yellow highlighter mark appears at the left margin of the second line.
Presenter static; the yellow marker mark at the left margin is slightly larger than before; page almost at rest.
Yellow highlighter bar grows rightward under the 'flexed wider' text; presenter and page unchanged.
Yellow bar extends along the line below the blue selection, still the start of the highlighter sweep.
Highlighter bar now wider and sitting between the two paragraphs; presenter and pointer unchanged.
Yellow bar moves down toward the next paragraph's first line; page and presenter static.
Yellow highlighter reaches 'The facility is subject' at the start of the second paragraph, text now marked.
Highlight extends along 'The facility is subject to a' in yellow; the previous bar above is gone, presenter unchanged.
GAP_COMPOSITION: hard cut from interest-expense table with presenter to the EBITDA table without presenter; red box starts drawing by the post tile.
Hard cut from chip, tag and man with speech bubble to an almost white frame; a dark card edge slides in from the left.
Fast scroll of the dark Mercatus page: NPV table region exits upward while the 'Which return metric' section rises.
Scroll continues quickly; FAQ-style headings and bullet lists move up and the page enlarges slightly.
Page zooms and scrolls further down into financing-structure text; header bar leaves the top of the frame.
Presenter disappears in one frame and the dark page jumps to a different scroll position (payback and IRR FAQ text).
Dark page begins cropping inward: top edge drops and left edge moves in around the heading and bullets; presenter stays.
Dark page crop contracts further: smaller rectangle with table rows being cut off at the bottom; presenter static.
Crop nearly finished: only the heading and three bullets remain in a small dark card on white; presenter unchanged.
